caption: The drawing depicts a long-sleeved dress with a wide, rounded neckline and a fitted waist. The dress is white or light cream in color and features an all-over pattern of small purple floral or geometric motifs evenly spaced across the fabric. The sleeves are full-length and loose, with the same motif pattern, and are gathered at the shoulders, creating a puffed effect. The waist is accentuated with a horizontal band that has red circular decorations or buttons, and the fabric at the waist is gathered, creating slight pleats. The dress appears to have a blue or teal lining or undergarment visible at the neckline and through the parted center where the outer layer opens slightly below the waist. The background is plain, with an off-white or beige tone, and there are no additional objects or elements present in the drawing. The artist's signature, "Lillian Struhl," is visible in the lower right corner.
title: Doll's Dress
